notes: Re-enables the notification bell from 1.25.0, now that the real cause of the earlier outage is confirmed: 1.25.0's update zip overwrote public/.htaccess, silently stripping a host-managed PHP-version directive (cPanel's 'AddHandler ea-php...' block) that this repo's own tracked copy didn't know about - not a bug in the bell's own code. 1.25.1 already stopped updates from touching public/.htaccess going forward, so this is safe to install through this Update page as normal. The bell's render hook is also now wrapped defensively, so even a future host-level hiccup there would just hide the icon rather than affect the rest of the panel. No database change in this update.
